Activist Sonam Wangchuk's health prompts court intervention amid hunger strike

Activist Sonam Wangchuk, on an indefinite hunger strike for over 20 days, has been shifted to a hospital. The Delhi High Court has ordered the government to monitor his health, emphasizing the value of every citizen's life. This development occurs amidst broader discussions about hunger strikes in Indian politics and calls from various groups, including the Congress party, for Wangchuk to end his protest.
